dog.description_text:
Warren is a playful, energetic little guy who is always ready to play, especially if there are toys or his puppy brother involved. He has a lot of puppy energy, but once it’s time to wind down, he loves nothing more than curling up for a good cuddle and nap. He’s a smart boy and already catching on to potty training. He’s using his pee pad about 50% of the time and getting better every day. He also sleeps through the night, which his foster parents definitely appreciate!
Warren is sweet, silly, cuddly, and just an all-around fun puppy. He’d love a home where he can keep playing, learning, and getting lots of love. ❤️

﻿Warren is approximately 0y 2m 11d old and may be 51 to 63 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
